name: setuid32
description: setuid32 sets the user ID for the calling process, supporting 32-bit IDs as an extension in Linux kernels. It is used to change the effective user ID, and if privileged, also affects real and saved user IDs. This call is handled transparently by glibc wrappers.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The user ID to set for the process

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real UID, but there was a temporary failure allocating kernel data structures, or it would exceed the RLIMIT_NPROC resource limit
The user ID specified in uid is not valid in this user namespace
The user is not privileged and uid does not match the real UID or saved set-user-ID of the calling process
